summary.text: Ron Tusler is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 3, who took office on January 3, 2017, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Michael Goodwin.

paragraphs.text: Ron Tusler won Assembly District 3 general elections in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024, according to Ballotpedia.
For 2025-2026 he chairs the Judiciary Committee and also sits on the Commerce, Constitution and Ethics, Insurance, and Science, Technology, and AI committees.
